formats.name: AI Agent Organizational Chart
formats.description: A hierarchical diagram illustrating an 'Orchestrator' managing multiple specialized AI agents, with visual connections indicating task flow, dependencies, and shared context.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a flowchart or organizational chart with distinct nodes for each AI agent and the orchestrator. Use arrows to show task handoffs and dependencies, and dotted lines for shared information or context.

formats.name: Brand Kit / Design System
formats.description: A structured presentation of a brand's visual identity, including color palettes, typography guidelines, and UI component examples, all adhering to a consistent aesthetic.
formats.rebuild_hint: Develop a design system document or web page that showcases primary and secondary color palettes, a complete type system (headings, body text, etc.), and examples of key UI components like buttons and input fields, ensuring brand consistency.

formats.name: Landing Page Hero Section
formats.description: A prominent, full-width section at the top of a webpage designed to immediately capture attention, featuring a bold headline, a clear call-to-action, and supporting text.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a hero section with a dark background, a large, impactful headline, a concise sub-headline, and a primary call-to-action button. Include navigation elements and potentially a secondary call-to-action.

formats.name: Email Newsletter Layout
formats.description: A template for email newsletters with a branded header, multiple content blocks for articles or updates, and call-to-action buttons, designed for readability and engagement.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design an email template with a dark color scheme, a clear header with branding, distinct content sections for different topics, and prominent call-to-action buttons to guide user interaction.

formats.name: Ad Creative Templates
formats.description: Reusable design patterns for digital advertisements in various aspect ratios, featuring bold headlines, concise messaging, and clear call-to-action buttons.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create ad templates for common aspect ratios (e.g., 1:1, 9:16) using a dark background, strong typography for headlines, minimal copy, and a contrasting call-to-action button to maximize visual impact.

formats.name: Course/Guide Layout with Navigation
formats.description: A common UI pattern for online courses or guides, featuring a persistent left-hand navigation menu that lists modules or sections, often with progress tracking. The main content area dynamically updates to display the selected module's information, which can include text, images, and interactive elements like prompts.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a responsive two-column layout. The left column should be a fixed-width sidebar for navigation, allowing users to toggle between modules. The right column should be the main content area, scrollable and designed to display various types of educational content. Include visual cues for progress.

formats.name: Copy-Paste Prompt Component
formats.description: A UI component designed to present actionable text prompts, typically for use with AI tools. It includes the prompt text, often with highlighted sections for user input, and a 'Copy' button to easily transfer the text to the clipboard. It may also include instructions or rules for effective use of the prompt.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a styled block or card component. Inside, include a text area or pre-formatted text block for the prompt. Add a 'Copy' button that, when clicked, copies the entire prompt text to the user's clipboard. Optionally, include instructional text or rules above/below the prompt.

formats.name: Sequential Workflow Orchestration
formats.description: A multi-step process where tasks are executed in a specific, predefined order, as illustrated by the 'Onboard New Customer' example.
formats.rebuild_hint: Define a series of sequential steps, where each step calls a specific tool or function with parameters, and subsequent steps can depend on the outputs of previous ones.

formats.name: Iterative Refinement
formats.description: A process designed to improve output quality through repeated cycles of generation, quality checking, issue identification, and refinement, as shown for 'Report generation'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a loop that starts with an initial draft, followed by a quality check, identification of issues, and a refinement step that addresses those issues, repeating until a quality threshold is met.

formats.name: Context-Aware Tool Selection
formats.description: A pattern where the choice of tools or actions is dynamically determined based on the specific context or characteristics of the input, exemplified by 'Smart File Storage'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Utilize a decision tree or conditional logic to select the most appropriate tool or action based on input attributes such as file type, size, or specific user requirements.

formats.name: Domain-Specific Intelligence
formats.description: A pattern where specialized knowledge and rules, beyond general tool access, are applied to tasks within a particular domain, such as 'Financial compliance'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Integrate domain-specific rules, compliance checks, and specialized decision-making processes directly into workflows to handle complex, industry-specific tasks.

formats.name: AI-driven Lead Generation & Marketing Flow
formats.description: A multi-step automated process for high-ticket sales, specifically demonstrated for pool building. It involves identifying potential customers via satellite imagery, extracting public data, AI-rendering product visuals onto their property, calculating costs/value, generating personalized marketing materials (postcards, videos), and executing retargeting ad campaigns.
formats.rebuild_hint: 1. Scrape satellite imagery for target properties (e.g., homes without pools, empty backyards). 2. Filter properties based on criteria (lot size, sun exposure, recent ownership change). 3. Extract homeowner data from public records. 4. Use AI to render product visuals (e.g., a pool) onto the property's satellite image. 5. Calculate estimated cost and value lift for the upgrade. 6. Generate 'before and after' videos/images. 7. Create personalized direct mail (e.g., postcards with QR codes linking to videos). 8. Implement digital retargeting campaigns on social media platforms for those leads.

formats.name: Tweet with Embedded Data Visualization
formats.description: A social media post layout that combines textual information with a statistical bar chart for data representation.
formats.rebuild_hint: Utilize a standard social media card component. Integrate a text block for the post content and an image or embedded graph component for data visualization. Ensure clear attribution for the data source.

formats.name: AI Chat Input Flow
formats.description: A user interaction pattern for submitting queries to an AI chatbot, featuring a distinct input field with branding and a send action.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design an input field with a clear visual identity (e.g., AI logo). Implement text input functionality and a button to submit the query. Consider real-time typing animation for user feedback.

formats.name: AI Chat Interface
formats.description: A common layout for AI chat applications, featuring a central input field for user queries, a display area for conversation history, and often a sidebar for navigation or tool selection.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a flexbox or grid layout for the main container. Implement a fixed-position input bar at the bottom. Use a scrollable div for chat history. A left-aligned sidebar for tool/bot selection.

formats.name: AI Image Generation Workflow
formats.description: A workflow where a user inputs a text prompt and selects an art style, then the system generates one or more images based on these inputs.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a form with a textarea for description and a dropdown for style. Implement a 'Generate' button. Display generated images in a gallery or side-by-side comparison.

formats.name: AI Image Editing Workflow
formats.description: A workflow where a user uploads an image and then uses natural language prompts or predefined options to modify aspects like lighting, colors, details, hairstyles, outfits, or backgrounds.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create an image display area. Implement a chat-like input for editing commands. Provide quick-access buttons for common edits (e.g., 'Image Edit', 'Image Generation').

formats.name: AI Workspace Dashboard
formats.description: A dashboard layout designed to provide quick access to various AI tools and functionalities, often featuring a search bar and categorized tool listings.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a prominent search bar at the top. Arrange tool categories as horizontal cards or buttons. Consider a grid or list view for detailed tool listings.

formats.name: Neural Expressive Design Language
formats.description: A design language that dynamically builds new displays, layouts, and modals based on user prompts, creating a new visual UI in real-time.
formats.rebuild_hint: Utilize AI models to generate UI components, layouts, and interactive elements on the fly, adapting to user input and contextual information.

formats.name: iOS Share Sheet
formats.description: A system-level modal overlay that appears from the bottom of the screen, displaying a horizontal scrollable row of app icons (favorites) and a vertical list of other actions below. It includes options like AirDrop, messaging apps, and AI tools.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a bottom sheet modal with a horizontal UICollectionView for favorite app icons and a UITableView for additional actions, allowing customization of icon order and visibility.

formats.name: Android Share Sheet
formats.description: A system-level modal overlay that appears from the bottom of the screen, displaying a preview of the shared content at the top, followed by a grid of app icons for sharing actions. It allows pinning frequently used apps to the top row.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a bottom sheet modal with a content preview area at the top and a scrollable GridLayout or RecyclerView for app icons, supporting long-press for pinning functionality.

formats.name: Multi-Agent Attack Flow
formats.description: A conceptual flow illustrating a coordinated multi-agent attack on an AI model, involving decomposing queries, tracking context, and reassembling output to bypass safety filters. Visually represented by a central point expanding into a hexagonal network of nodes, then collapsing back.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a process where a complex task is broken into multiple sub-tasks (sub-queries), each handled by a separate agent or module. Implement context tracking to maintain coherence across these sub-tasks, and a final reassembly step to combine the results. Ensure each sub-task appears innocuous to bypass safety mechanisms.

formats.name: CLI Model Selection
formats.description: A command-line interface pattern for selecting options from a numbered list, often used for configuring tool behavior or AI models.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a text-based menu with numbered options. Capture user input for selection. Display descriptions for each option.

formats.name: CLI Conversation Log with Commands
formats.description: A terminal-style layout for displaying chat history, system messages, and command outputs, including error logs, in a sequential manner.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a fixed-width font and dark background. Implement a scrollable text area for history and a separate input line for commands. Format system messages and errors distinctly.

formats.name: Resume Experience Section (Bullet Points)
formats.description: A list of bullet points detailing work experience, often starting with action verbs and including quantifiable achievements.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use bullet points for each achievement. Start with a strong action verb. Quantify results (X) and explain how they were achieved (Y) and what action was taken (Z) using the Google X-Y-Z formula.

formats.name: Google X-Y-Z Formula
formats.description: A structured way to write resume bullet points: 'Accomplished X, as measured by Y, by doing Z'.
formats.rebuild_hint: For each achievement, identify the accomplishment (X), the measurable result (Y), and the action taken (Z). Combine them into a single, concise sentence.

formats.name: ATS Scan Results
formats.description: A structured output from an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) bot, highlighting problems with a resume's layout or content that might hinder automated parsing.
formats.rebuild_hint: Present findings with numbered problems, a clear problem statement, and reasons why an ATS would struggle (e.g., 'Graphic-heavy Canva-style resumes often use:').

formats.name: Interview Question & Answer Simulation
formats.description: A simulated interview where a bot acts as a hiring manager, asks technical questions, and then provides ideal answers based on a given background.
formats.rebuild_hint: Define the role and background. Generate specific technical questions. For each question, craft a detailed, relevant answer that leverages the provided background and experience.

formats.name: Cinematic follower flex edits
formats.description: A type of social media content showing an individual surrounded by a large, AI-generated crowd, implying a large follower count. It involves generating a stylized image and then animating it into a vertical video.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use an AI image generator to create a stylized image of a person surrounded by a crowd, then use an AI video generator to animate the image with camera movement and subtle crowd motion, formatted for social media.

formats.name: Research Paper Layout
formats.description: A standard academic paper layout featuring a title, date, icons for related platforms, an abstract-like description, a comparative bar chart, and a detailed benchmark table. Includes sections for getting started.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a clean, multi-section layout with clear headings. Use a combination of text, images, and tables to present information. Ensure good readability with appropriate typography and spacing.

formats.name: Comparative Bar Chart
formats.description: A bar chart comparing the performance scores of multiple AI models (GLM-5.1, GLM-5, GPT-5.4, Opus 4.6, Gemini 1.0 Pro) on 'Complex Software Engineering Tasks' (SWE-Bench Pro). Each bar is colored differently and displays its numerical score.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a charting library to create a bar chart. Clearly label the x-axis with model names and the y-axis with scores. Display numerical values on top of each bar for easy comparison. Use distinct colors for each bar.

formats.name: Hugging Face Model Card Layout
formats.description: A structured layout for presenting AI models on a platform like Hugging Face, including model name, organization, descriptive tags, and tabbed navigation for different aspects of the model (e.g., Model card, Files and versions, Community).
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a page with a prominent title and subtitle. Implement a tag system for categorization. Use a tabbed interface for organizing detailed information about the model, its files, and community discussions.

formats.name: Task List with Properties
formats.description: A structured list format where each item (task) has various associated properties and a dedicated section for an overview or sub-tasks.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a database or table structure with custom fields for properties and a rich text area for task overview. Implement filtering and sorting based on properties.

formats.name: Creative Asset Grid
formats.description: A grid-based display for visual assets, where each asset is represented by a card containing a thumbnail, title, and status indicator.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a responsive grid layout using CSS Grid or Flexbox. Each grid item should be a card component with an image/video placeholder, text overlay, and status badge.

formats.name: Chat Interface with Embedded Links and Lists
formats.description: A conversational interface allowing users to interact with an agent, where instructions can be provided as bulleted lists and include embedded hyperlinks.
formats.rebuild_hint: Develop a chat UI with message bubbles. Implement markdown rendering for lists and automatic detection/rendering of hyperlinks. Ensure bot messages are distinguishable from user messages.

formats.name: Batch Management Dashboard
formats.description: A dashboard for managing grouped items (batches) with status indicators and actions, allowing for bulk operations.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a main dashboard layout with collapsible sections for different batch types. Each batch item should display its name, status, and relevant actions (e.g., 'Launch'). Use a clear visual hierarchy for statuses.

formats.name: Ad Campaign Table
formats.description: A tabular display for managing advertising campaigns, showing key metrics and providing options for editing, duplicating, and previewing ads.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a data table component with sortable columns for metrics. Implement checkboxes for bulk selection and action buttons for common tasks like 'Edit' or 'Preview'. Include a search/filter bar.

formats.name: Ad Preview Modal
formats.description: A modal window for previewing ad creatives across different placements and versions.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a modal component that overlays the main content. Inside, display multiple ad previews (e.g., mobile feed, story) side-by-side or in a carousel. Include a dropdown for selecting different ad versions.

formats.name: Terminal Command Interface
formats.description: A command-line interface with a prompt, commands, and text-based output, including status messages and interactive prompts for model selection.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a terminal emulator, monospace font, and custom color scheme (dark background, colored text for different elements like commands, output, and status). Implement command parsing and output rendering.

formats.name: Model Listing with Tags
formats.description: A list of models, each with a name, description, and categorized tags (e.g., 'vision', 'tools', 'thinking', 'cloud', 'size'). Includes download/pull counts and update timestamps.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a grid or list layout. Each item should have a title, a short description, and a row of clickable/filterable tags. Include metadata like download counts and last updated date. Implement search and filtering.

formats.name: Software Download Page
formats.description: A page offering software downloads for different operating systems, with tabs for each OS, installation instructions (e.g., PowerShell command), and a prominent download button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a tabbed interface for OS selection. Each tab should display relevant installation instructions (e.g., command line snippets) and a primary download button. Include system requirements.

formats.name: OODA Loop Framework
formats.description: A four-step decision-making cycle (Observe, Orient, Decide, Act) used for continuous learning and adjustment, particularly for problem-solving or strategy.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a cyclical process with distinct stages for observation, interpretation, decision-making, and action, with feedback loops.

formats.name: Four-Card Project Layout
formats.description: A layout featuring four distinct cards, each representing a project or category, with an icon, title, and descriptive text/examples.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a grid or flexbox to arrange four cards. Each card should have an icon, a bold title, and a list of bullet points or descriptive text. Use distinct background colors or borders for each card.

formats.name: Two-Column File Description Layout
formats.description: A layout presenting two distinct sections side-by-side, each detailing a 'file' or set of instructions with bullet points and examples.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a two-column grid or flexbox. Each column should contain a header, a list of bullet points, and an example text block. Use different background colors for each column to differentiate.

formats.name: Guided Setup Flow
formats.description: A step-by-step onboarding or setup process presented as a numbered checklist with titles, descriptions, and completion indicators.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a vertical list of numbered items. Each item includes a title, a brief description, and a visual indicator (e.g., a checkmark) for completion. Use a clear visual hierarchy for current vs. completed steps.

formats.name: Circular App Integration Diagram
formats.description: A diagram showing a central application connected to multiple external applications arranged in a circle around it.
formats.rebuild_hint: Place a central icon/logo. Arrange other application icons/logos in a circle around the central one, with lines or implied connections. Add a label for the external apps.

formats.name: Three-Column Feature Display
formats.description: A layout displaying three distinct features or options side-by-side, each with an icon, title, description, and an associated action.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a three-column grid or flexbox. Each column should contain an icon, a bold title, a descriptive paragraph, and a button or status indicator at the bottom.

formats.name: User Profile Update Form
formats.description: A UI pattern for updating user information, specifically an email address, demonstrating how a new value overwrites the old one in a 'current state only' database.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a simple form with a text input for email and an update button. Implement logic to replace the existing email with the new one upon submission.

formats.name: Event Stream Visualization
formats.description: A visual representation of a sequence of immutable events, showing how each event contributes to the current state of an entity. It includes event blocks and a derived current state box.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a timeline or flowchart using connected rectangular nodes for events and a separate node for the current state. Each event node should contain a description of the change.

formats.name: Side-by-Side Comparison Cards
formats.description: A layout pattern for comparing two different approaches or data representations (e.g., 'scoreboard' vs. 'play-by-play') using distinct, bordered cards.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a flexbox or grid layout to place two distinct card-like UI elements side-by-side. Each card should have a title, border, and content area to display comparative information.

formats.name: Agent Loop Pattern
formats.description: A reusable UI/layout pattern for an iterative agent process, starting with a user prompt, moving through context assembly, tool requests, permission checks, execution, and culminating in an assistant response.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design as a flowchart with a central loop. Use distinct blocks for each step and arrows to indicate flow. Include conditional branches for permissions and tool usage.

formats.name: Context Window Layering
formats.description: A structured display of different context types, organized into distinct layers (e.g., System, Project Config, Memory, Conversation, Runtime, On-Demand) to manage information for an AI agent.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use stacked, colored rectangular blocks for each layer. List specific context elements as sub-items within each layer.

formats.name: Circular AI Agent System Overview
formats.description: A conceptual layout showing a central AI component surrounded by a ring of supporting functions and data sources, illustrating the comprehensive ecosystem around an AI agent.
formats.rebuild_hint: Place a central icon for the AI. Arrange supporting components in a circle around it, connected by dashed lines to the center.

formats.name: European Map with Location Markers
formats.description: A stylized map of Europe in a metallic gold/bronze color, with small, light-colored human-like icons placed at various locations to denote supercomputing centers or AI factories.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a vector map of Europe, apply a metallic texture/gradient, and place custom icons at specific coordinates.

formats.name: Partner/Location List with Logos
formats.description: A vertical list of names, some accompanied by small logos, presented in white text against a dark background.
formats.rebuild_hint: A simple unordered list with text and inline image elements, styled with white text on a dark background.

formats.name: AI Infrastructure Growth Bar Chart
formats.description: A bar chart showing growth projection over years (2024, 2025, 2026) for 'GPU/Sh' with green bars. The 2025 bar is labeled '3X+' and the 2026 bar is significantly taller, implying '10X'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a charting library (e.g., Chart.js, D3.js) to create a bar chart with a dark background, green bars, and specific labels for years and growth factors.

formats.name: Animated Stick Figures
formats.description: Simple, minimalist stick figures used to convey abstract concepts, interactions, and scenarios in a clear, relatable, and often humorous manner. They interact with text bubbles, objects, and other figures to illustrate points about AI and human skills.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use simple vector graphics for characters with basic shapes and colors. Employ minimal backgrounds and clear, legible text bubbles or labels to convey dialogue or concepts. Animate movements to be fluid but simple, focusing on conveying the idea rather than complex visuals.

formats.name: Comprehensive Content Strategy Document Layout
formats.description: A structured multi-page document format for a content strategy, including an executive summary, measurable targets, business context, detailed customer personas, and a content playbook.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a document with distinct sections for executive summary, targets (using tables), business context, persona descriptions, and content strategy details. Utilize clear headings and bullet points.

formats.name: Facebook Ad Creative Layout
formats.description: A standard Facebook ad layout comprising a main image, a headline, descriptive text, and a call-to-action button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design an image with product and lifestyle elements. Overlay a clear headline and offer text. Include a prominent call-to-action button.

formats.name: Terminal-based AI Assistant
formats.description: An interactive command-line interface where an AI agent responds to natural language prompts, executes commands, plans tasks, writes code, and shows diffs, with features like model switching and command palettes.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a command-line interface using a terminal emulator, integrate with various AI models for natural language processing and code generation, display code diffs, and include keyboard shortcuts for navigation and commands.

formats.name: Operator Task Breakdown
formats.description: Visual representation of tasks handled by an operator: Strategy, Customer relationships, Distribution, Quality control.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use text labels connected by dashed lines to a central point representing the operator.

formats.name: Cost vs. Margins Graph
formats.description: A line graph illustrating how increasing costs lead to decreasing margins in traditional business models.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a 2D line graph with 'Cost' increasing and 'Margins' decreasing over time/scale.

formats.name: Solo Founder Tool Stack Cost Breakdown
formats.description: A visual breakdown of annual and monthly costs for a solo founder's AI tool stack.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use stacked bar charts or distinct text boxes to show different cost tiers (e.g., $3,000/year, $12,000/year, $200-$1,000/month).

formats.name: Progress Checklist
formats.description: A checklist component showing tasks with checkboxes and completion status.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a card with a title 'Progress' and a list of items with checkboxes, some checked, some unchecked.

formats.name: Outcome-Based Pricing Diagram
formats.description: Illustrates how automating a process saves money for the customer, allowing the product to capture a portion of that saved value.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use icons for 'company' and 'product box', connected by dashed lines, with money icons representing savings and captured value. Text overlays explain the win-win scenario.

formats.name: AI Correction Tracking List
formats.description: A numbered list displaying individual correction attempts for an AI, indicating success or failure and a maximum limit for corrections.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a list component with distinct styling for each item, including a number, text input, and a status icon (e.g., 'x failed'). Implement a counter and a visual limit indicator.

formats.name: AI Effectiveness Gauge
formats.description: A horizontal slider or progress bar visually representing the AI's performance or 'mood' (e.g., 'Working with you' vs 'Working against you'), with an indicator moving based on interaction outcomes.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a custom slider or progress bar with two labeled endpoints. An animated indicator (e.g., a sun icon) should move along the bar based on a calculated 'success rate' or 'failure count'.

formats.name: AI Context Window Display
formats.description: A dedicated window showing a list of 'wrong fixes' that are 'still loaded' in the AI's current context, highlighting accumulated errors.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a scrollable card or panel component. Inside, list items with a descriptive text (e.g., 'wrong fix - added a try/catch') and a status tag (e.g., 'still loaded').

formats.name: Clean Session Prompt Form
formats.description: A prompt input form designed for a 'clean session', including fields to incorporate specific learnings from previous failures (e.g., 'the constraint it missed', 'the file it ignored').
formats.rebuild_hint: Develop a multi-input form with a primary text area for the main prompt and additional, structured input fields for specific details or constraints learned from prior attempts.

formats.name: Sidebar Navigation
formats.description: A vertical navigation menu with distinct sections for chat and project-oriented work, allowing users to switch between modes and access features.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a vertical menu with clickable items, including icons and text labels, highlighting the active selection.

formats.name: Task-Oriented AI Interface
formats.description: An AI interface designed for managing tasks and projects, with specific options for scheduling, live artifacts, and dispatch, alongside a primary task input.
formats.rebuild_hint: Adapt the chat interface with project-specific navigation in the sidebar and task management features in the main content area.

formats.name: App Connector Grid
formats.description: A grid-based display of available applications for integration, with search and filter functionality, allowing users to easily add new connections.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a responsive grid for app cards, each with a name, description, and an 'add' button. Include a search bar and filter dropdowns at the top.

formats.name: Skill Instruction Form
formats.description: A form for defining custom AI skills with a name, description, and detailed instructions on how the skill should operate.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a modal or form with text input fields for skill name and description, and a larger textarea for detailed instructions.

formats.name: Business Proposal Document
formats.description: A structured business proposal format including key sections like vendor details, engagement scope, financial terms, project timeline, and client responsibilities.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a multi-section document layout with clear headings, bullet points, and tables for presenting detailed information in a professional manner.

formats.name: Project Card Layout
formats.description: A reusable UI pattern for displaying summaries of individual projects or items in a grid or list, typically showing a title, brief description, and a timestamp.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a grid or flexbox layout for cards. Each card should have a border-radius, padding, and contain text elements for title, description, and metadata. Implement hover states for interactivity.

formats.name: AI Chat Interface with Context Panels
formats.description: A two-column layout combining a conversational AI chat on one side with persistent, structured context panels (e.g., 'Memory', 'Instructions', 'Files') on the other, providing the AI with relevant information for the conversation.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a split-panel layout. The left panel for chat should include an input field, message history, and model selection. The right panel should have collapsible or tabbed sections for different context types, displaying relevant data.

formats.name: Modal Instruction Editor
formats.description: A pop-up dialog box used for inputting and saving detailed, multi-line instructions or configuration for a specific project or AI agent.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a modal component with a title, descriptive text, a large textarea for input, and action buttons (Cancel, Save) at the bottom. Ensure it overlays the main content and can be dismissed.

formats.name: Sidebar Navigation with Recent Items
formats.description: A vertical navigation bar on the left side of the screen, featuring primary application sections and a dynamic list of recently accessed items or sessions.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a fixed-position sidebar. Include a list of main navigation links (icons + text) and a separate section for 'Recent' items, which are dynamically populated. Use active states for selected items.

formats.name: Markdown Wiki/Knowledge Base
formats.description: A system for organizing and displaying interconnected notes using markdown formatting, often featuring a file explorer for navigation and a main content area for viewing and editing documents.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a two-column layout. The left column is a tree-view file explorer for markdown files. The right column is a markdown renderer/editor, supporting internal links, headings, and lists. Ensure a clean, readable typography.

formats.name: Context Window Visualization
formats.description: A visual representation of an AI model's context window, showing how different parts of a conversation (task, response, side questions/answers) occupy space and can lead to 'context pollution'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a horizontal progress bar component with distinct, color-coded segments representing different types of conversational input/output. Implement dynamic labeling and visual indicators for 'permanent' context and 'wasted' space.

formats.name: Master Statement
formats.description: A short profile containing information about how the user learns, their skills, goals, and current work, designed to be dropped into AI chats to provide persistent context.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a concise text document outlining your learning style, key skills, professional goals, and current projects. This statement should be easily copy-pable to introduce yourself to an AI at the start of a new chat or project.

formats.name: Split Panel Code Editor
formats.description: A common layout for code editors with a file tree on the left and code editor/terminal on the right.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a flexbox or grid layout with two main columns. Implement a resizable divider between panels. Left panel for navigation/files, right for content/code. Include tabs for different views (Preview, Diff, Terminal, Plan).

formats.name: Multi-Column AI Dashboard
formats.description: A dashboard layout with multiple vertical columns, each dedicated to a different business function (Sales, Finance, Legal) and containing context/skill panels.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a CSS grid or flexbox to create multiple columns. Each column should contain a card-like component with a title, content area, and potentially dropdowns for 'Context' and 'Skills'.

formats.name: Chat-based AI Interaction
formats.description: A user interaction flow starting with a chat input, allowing selection of 'Chat' or 'Cowork' mode, and showing a step-by-step progress indicator for tasks.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a chat interface with an input field and send button. Add toggle buttons for different modes. Use a list or step-by-step component to display task progress.

formats.name: Integrations/App Store Grid
formats.description: A grid-based display for available integrations/apps, with search functionality and individual cards for each integration.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a CSS grid to display integration cards. Implement a search bar at the top. Each card should include an icon, name, and a brief description. Include a modal for access granting.

formats.name: Cinematic Camera Angles for AI Designs
formats.description: A collection of various camera angles (Close Up, Extreme Close Up, POV, Medium Shot, Low Angle Shot, Over The Shoulder, High Angle Shot, Tracking Shot, Reveal Shot, Wide Shot, Dutch Angle, Birds Eye View) applied to AI-generated images to achieve a more professional and dynamic look.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use specific camera angle prompts like 'fish-eye distortion', 'Dutch angle', 'extreme close-up', 'overhead shots', 'POV framing', 'low-angle hero shot' in AI image generation tools. Combine with lens, lighting, aspect ratio, style, and quality settings.

formats.name: AI Summarization Prompt
formats.description: A structured prompt for an AI to summarize a long document into key takeaways, focusing on specific aspects like pain points, buying behavior, and trends.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a large language model like ChatGPT. Provide the prompt: 'SUMMARIZE THIS [NUMBER]-PAGE [DOCUMENT TYPE] INTO [NUMBER] KEY TAKEAWAYS. FOCUS ON [ASPECT 1], [ASPECT 2], AND [ASPECT 3]: [INSERT DOCUMENT TEXT]'. Replace bracketed items with specific details.

formats.name: Product Comparison Table Layout
formats.description: A tabular layout used to compare multiple products or services across several key attributes like 'What It Is', 'Access', and 'Best For'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a multi-column table with distinct headers for product attributes and populate rows with specific product details.

formats.name: Terminal Status Bar
formats.description: A horizontal status bar integrated into a terminal interface, showing real-time metrics such as session token limits and plan quotas (e.g., 5-hour and 7-day windows) with visual progress bars and percentage indicators.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a custom status line within a terminal emulator or IDE. This would involve scripting to fetch API usage data and render it as text and ASCII-art progress bars in a dedicated line at the bottom of the terminal window.

formats.name: AI Agent Chat Interface
formats.description: A conversational interface pattern where a user interacts with an AI agent through a messaging application (like iMessage) using natural language, receiving structured or summarized responses.
formats.rebuild_hint: Integrate an AI model with a messaging platform API (e.g., iMessage, WhatsApp) to enable conversational interaction. Design message parsing for user queries and response generation for AI output, potentially including structured data or summaries.

formats.name: Funnel Diagram
formats.description: A vertical flow diagram showing stages of a business funnel, from organic content to different revenue streams (courses, community, agency) with associated earnings.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a series of stacked rectangular boxes with arrows indicating flow. Each box contains a label and a monetary value. A main title box sits at the top.

formats.name: Instagram DM Funnel Diagram
formats.description: A vertical flow diagram illustrating the steps of an Instagram direct message sales funnel, from lead magnet to upselling offers.
formats.rebuild_hint: Similar to the general funnel diagram, use stacked rectangular boxes with labels like 'Lead Magnet', 'DM Automation', 'Free Value Content', 'Upselling my offers', connected by arrows.

formats.name: Workflow Builder
formats.description: A visual, node-based interface for creating automation workflows, allowing users to define triggers, conditions, and actions.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a canvas with a grid background. Create draggable and connectable 'nodes' representing steps (e.g., 'Send Text Message', 'Condition', 'AI Step'). Use lines/arrows to show the flow between nodes, supporting conditional branching.

formats.name: Integration Card
formats.description: A UI component used to display information about a third-party service that can be connected, including its logo, name, description, and an action button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a rectangular card with rounded corners. Place a service logo at the top, followed by the service name, a short descriptive text, and a 'Create Integration' button at the bottom.

formats.name: Template Card
formats.description: A UI component for showcasing pre-built automation templates, featuring an icon, template title, description, and an 'Import' button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a rectangular card with rounded corners. Include an icon (e.g., Instagram logo) at the top, a template title, a brief description of the automation, and an 'Import' button at the bottom.

formats.name: Social Media Post Card
formats.description: A reusable UI pattern for displaying a single social media post, including author details, content, timestamp, and interaction buttons.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a card component with a header for user info (avatar, name, handle), a main body for text content, and a footer for engagement metrics and actions. Implement dark mode styling with white text and blue accents.

formats.name: Scheduled Task Configuration
formats.description: A UI pattern for defining and configuring automated tasks, including a natural language prompt input, and structured fields for frequency (daily, weekly, custom), specific time, and repeat settings.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a text input field for a natural language prompt. Below it, display configurable options for task scheduling: 'Repeat' (dropdown: Custom), 'Frequency' (dropdown: Daily), 'Time' (input: 6:00 AM), and 'End repeat' (dropdown: Never). Include a 'Next run' display. This can be built using standard form elements and a backend scheduling service.

formats.name: Plugin Marketplace/Browser
formats.description: A section of an application UI dedicated to discovering and managing integrations or extensions (plugins). It features a list of installed plugins (often as icons) and a categorized list of available plugins with descriptions and installation options.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a main content area with two sub-sections: 'Installed' and 'Featured'. The 'Installed' section should display a horizontal scrollable list of small icons representing active plugins. The 'Featured' section should list available plugins, grouped by categories (e.g., 'Productivity', 'Communication'). Each plugin entry should include an icon, name, short description, and an 'Add' button. Implement a search bar for filtering plugins.

formats.name: Numbered Listicle with Icons
formats.description: A vertical list format where each item is numbered, includes a unique icon, a main title, and a brief explanatory subtitle. Used for presenting a series of distinct points.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a flexbox or grid layout for each item, with an icon on the left, and stacked title/subtitle on the right. Apply distinct background colors to the number circles for visual separation.

formats.name: Structured AI Prompt for Text Refinement
formats.description: A multi-part text prompt designed to guide an AI in rewriting text. It includes sections for 'stripping out' undesirable elements (like specific words, transitions, or sentence structures), 'keeping' core meaning, and a 'read back' self-correction step, followed by a placeholder for the input text.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a text area or code block with clear headings and numbered instructions. Use bullet points or numbered lists for specific instructions within the prompt. Include a placeholder for user-provided text.

formats.name: Data Table
formats.description: A structured grid for presenting numerical data with clear headers and rows, used for displaying usage limits.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use HTML <table> or a UI component library's table component for structured data presentation.

formats.name: Blog Post/Announcement Layout
formats.description: A clean web page structure with a prominent title, date, and body text, often including images or graphics, suitable for official announcements or blog entries.
formats.rebuild_hint: Standard web page structure with a header, main content area, and potentially a sidebar for navigation or related content.

formats.name: Three-Column Comparison Card Layout
formats.description: A layout featuring three distinct cards, each representing a different level or product, with a title and an icon. The cards are arranged horizontally.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a flexbox or grid layout to arrange three cards side-by-side. Each card should have a title (e.g., 'CLAUDE'), an icon, and potentially a subtitle or description. Use distinct background colors for each card to differentiate them.

formats.name: LLM Council Output Structure
formats.description: A structured output format that frames a question, provides context and stakes, then presents individual responses from multiple 'advisors' (AI agents) before a final decision from a 'chairman agent'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use clear headings for 'Framed Question', 'Core decision', 'Context', 'What's at stake', 'The Five Advisors' (with sub-headings for each advisor's role and analysis), and a concluding 'Chairman Agent' summary.

formats.name: Network Graph Visualization
formats.description: A dynamic graph structure where nodes represent entities (people, files) and edges represent relationships or activities between them. Features glowing effects and continuous motion.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a force-directed graph layout algorithm with glowing node and edge rendering. Implement real-time data updates to animate changes in connections and node states. Incorporate a legend for node types/colors and a timeline for activity progression.

formats.name: File Type Activity Legend
formats.description: A vertical list displaying file extensions (e.g., md, js, json) with corresponding counts, color-coded to match file nodes in the main visualization.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a UI component with a list of text labels and numerical counts. Assign distinct colors to each file type, ensuring consistency with the main visualization.

formats.name: AI Prompt Input Field
formats.description: A text input field designed for natural language prompts, often accompanied by model version information.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a standard text input component with a placeholder. Add a label or small text for model version/context. Consider an icon for visual branding.

formats.name: Multi-step Progress List
formats.description: A UI pattern showing a list of steps or sections, with visual indicators (e.g., checkmarks, loading spinners) for their completion status.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement as an ordered or unordered list. Each list item should include a label and an icon/component to represent its state (completed, in progress, pending).

formats.name: Data Spreadsheet/Table
formats.description: A grid-based layout for displaying structured data with columns and rows, similar to a spreadsheet application.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use an HTML table or a data grid component. Ensure proper headers for columns and clear separation of rows. Implement sorting and filtering if needed.

formats.name: Terminal Output with Formatted Report
formats.description: A command-line interface display that shows both user input commands and structured text output, including tables and summaries.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a monospace font within a dark-themed container. Commands can be prefixed with a prompt. Output should be clearly formatted, using ASCII art for tables or pre-formatted text blocks.

formats.name: Split-Screen Video Layout
formats.description: A video format where the main subject (robot action) is displayed in the top half of the screen, and a narrator is shown in the bottom half, often with a microphone visible.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a video editing software to create two distinct video tracks, one for the main content and one for the narrator, and position them in a top-bottom split. Ensure consistent aspect ratios for both sections.

formats.name: 2x2 Matrix Diagram
formats.description: A diagram format used to categorize or compare concepts along two axes, creating four distinct quadrants.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a grid with two rows and two columns. Label the X and Y axes. Place relevant content (text, images) within each of the four cells.

formats.name: AI Edit Workflow
formats.description: A reusable sequence of AI operations (e.g., dithering, retro CRT effect) that can be saved as a 'skill' and applied to multiple assets.
formats.rebuild_hint: Define a series of AI prompts/edits, save them as a named 'skill' with a slash command, and apply this skill to various images or videos.

formats.name: Smart Resized Variants
formats.description: Automatically generates multiple resized versions of an image for different channels/platforms, maintaining content and context.
formats.rebuild_hint: Take a single image asset, apply AI-driven smart resizing to generate variants for different aspect ratios (e.g., feed square, feed portrait, in-stream landscape).

formats.name: Brand Kit
formats.description: A centralized repository for brand assets including logos, colors (with hex codes), fonts, and visual guidelines, automatically pulled from a company domain.
formats.rebuild_hint: Input a company domain to automatically generate a brand kit with logos, color palettes, and fonts, or manually configure these elements.

formats.name: E-commerce Checkout Flow
formats.description: A multi-step process for purchasing items online, including order summary, discount application, and payment selection.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a cart summary, discount code input, and payment gateway integration. Ensure real-time price updates upon discount application.

formats.name: Tabbed Interface
formats.description: A UI pattern allowing users to switch between different sections or modes within an application, such as 'Chat' and 'Work' in ChatGPT.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use tab components with clear labels and visual indicators for the active tab. Ensure smooth transitions between content sections.

formats.name: Discount Code Results Table
formats.description: A structured table displaying various discount codes, their benefits, and conditions, allowing for easy comparison.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a responsive table with columns for 'Offer/code', 'Discount', 'Price', and 'Conditions/confidence'. Populate with dynamic data and include status indicators.

formats.name: AI Focus Group / Council Decision-Making
formats.description: A structured AI interaction pattern where the AI is prompted to act as multiple distinct advisors (e.g., skeptic, numbers person, growth person, outsider, doer), each arguing a specific perspective on a given decision. After all arguments are presented, a 'chairman' persona synthesizes the input, provides a verdict, and suggests the first actionable steps.
formats.rebuild_hint: Craft a detailed prompt for an AI (like Claude or ChatGPT) instructing it to adopt 5-6 distinct personas with specific viewpoints (e.g., skeptic, ROI-focused, growth-oriented, outsider, doer). Provide the decision context and ask each persona to argue their case. Conclude by asking a 'chairman' persona to weigh all arguments and provide a final verdict with actionable steps.

formats.name: Video Player Layout with Integrated Captions
formats.description: A video player interface that integrates real-time AI-generated captions, enlarges high-contrast visuals, and reads menus aloud for accessibility.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a video player with dynamic text overlay for captions, adjustable visual contrast/size, and text-to-speech functionality for UI elements.

formats.name: Tactile Braille-like Interface
formats.description: A physical board that converts digital text into responsive, Braille-like tactile bumps for hands-on learning.
formats.rebuild_hint: Develop a haptic feedback system or a reconfigurable pin array to represent text as tactile patterns on a surface.

formats.name: Inclusive App Mode UI
formats.description: An application interface designed to adapt any app into an 'inclusive mode' using smart prompts and presets, featuring a search, list, and icon grid.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create an app wrapper or plugin system that applies accessibility presets and uses AI prompts to modify existing app UIs for inclusive access.

formats.name: AI-generated High-Fidelity Design
formats.description: A complete, visually appealing UI design generated from a natural language prompt, including layout, components, and styling.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a design AI tool like Claude Design or Open Design with a detailed natural language prompt describing the desired app functionality, aesthetic, and specific elements.

formats.name: Chat Widget UI
formats.description: A floating chat interface typically positioned in the bottom right corner of a website. It includes a greeting message ('Hi! How can I help you today?') and a text input field ('Ask me anything') for user interaction.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a fixed-position div element for the chat widget. Inside, include a header, a greeting text area, and an input field for user messages. Style it with rounded corners and a shadow to resemble a chat bubble.

formats.name: Blog Post Layout
formats.description: A common web page layout for articles, featuring a main content area for text and images, often with a header, navigation, and a sidebar for additional elements like a chat widget.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a responsive layout using CSS Grid or Flexbox. Define a main content area for the article text and images, and a separate sidebar for supplementary content or interactive elements like a chat widget.

formats.name: Property Details Section
formats.description: A structured display of property information including images, price, number of bedrooms, property type, and key features, designed for easy readability.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a card-like component or a dedicated section. Include an image gallery or carousel at the top, followed by clear headings for 'Property Details' and a list of features (e.g., price, bed count, type, availability, specific amenities) using bullet points or structured text.

formats.name: File Listing Output
formats.description: A plain text list of files and directories, typically seen in a terminal or file explorer, showing file names.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a monospaced font. List items line by line.

formats.name: Glossary Definition Pop-up
formats.description: A small, dark-themed pop-up box providing a definition for a highlighted term, with a close button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a modal or tooltip component with a dark background, light text, and a close icon. Position it near the defined term.

formats.name: AI Lead Reactivation Flow
formats.description: A conversational AI flow designed to reactivate old leads by asking qualifying questions (quantity, age, average client worth, closing rate) and then calculating potential revenue to incentivize scheduling an appointment.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a multi-step conversational AI script that dynamically calculates potential value based on user input and offers a direct scheduling link to convert qualified leads.

formats.name: Chat Interface
formats.description: A standard chat layout with an input field at the bottom and contextual action buttons.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a text input area, a submit button, and a row of action buttons below the input. Implement a left-side navigation for main features.

formats.name: Settings Panel with Left Navigation
formats.description: A common UI pattern for settings, featuring a vertical navigation menu on the left and detailed settings options on the right.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a two-column layout. The left column contains a list of setting categories. The right column displays the content for the selected category, including input fields, dropdowns, and toggles.

formats.name: Project/Folder List
formats.description: A hierarchical list displaying projects or folders, with options to create new ones.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a scrollable list component. Each item in the list represents a project or folder, potentially with an icon and path. Include buttons for 'Create new project' and 'Choose a different folder' at the bottom.

formats.name: App Connector Cards Grid
formats.description: A grid display of application connectors, each with a title, description, and an action button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a responsive grid layout. Each grid cell contains a card component. The card should include an icon, title, short description, and a button (e.g., '+') for integration.

formats.name: AI Chat Settings Panel
formats.description: A dark-themed settings panel within an AI chat application, featuring a list of categories (e.g., Personal, Settings, Connectors) in a sidebar and a main content area for profile preferences, including a dropdown for work description and a multi-line text input for defining AI response guidelines.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a left-aligned sidebar for navigation with distinct icons/text for categories. The main content area should feature form elements like dropdowns and textareas. Use a dark background, light text, and clearly visible 'Cancel' and 'Save changes' buttons at the bottom.

formats.name: File Activity Network Graph
formats.description: A network graph displaying a user's interactions and changes across various file types over time. Nodes represent individual files and the user, connected by edges that highlight activity. The graph dynamically updates, showing new files, connections, and changes in file counts.
formats.rebuild_hint: Utilize a graph visualization library (e.g., D3.js, Cytoscape.js) to render nodes and edges. Map file extensions to distinct colors for nodes. Implement a time-series data input to animate the addition/removal of nodes and edges, and changes in node properties (like glow or color intensity) to represent activity. Display a legend for file types and counts, and a timestamp for the current state.

formats.name: AI Agent Status/Diagnostic Report
formats.description: A structured terminal output providing a diagnostic overview of an AI agent system, including local tool availability, token budget usage for various contexts (AGENTS.md, route index, discipline protocol, lanes, skills registry), project context warnings, and a summary of failures and warnings.
formats.rebuild_hint: Display categorized lists of checks (e.g., 'Local tools', 'Token budgets', 'Project context') with 'PASS' or 'WARN' indicators and detailed messages. Include a summary section at the end.

formats.name: AI-Generated Development Plan
formats.description: A detailed, numbered development plan generated by an AI agent for implementing a feature (e.g., Google Authentication). It breaks down the task into major steps, each with sub-points, considerations, and specific actions, including security checks, testing, and release steps.
formats.rebuild_hint: Present a numbered list of major development phases. Under each phase, use bullet points or sub-numbered lists for specific tasks, recommendations, and checklists. Highlight key terms or URLs within the text.

formats.name: E-BOOK
formats.description: A digital book sold as a one-time purchase.

formats.name: COURSE
formats.description: An online educational course sold as a one-time purchase.

formats.name: PDF
formats.description: A digital document, typically an informational product, sold as a one-time purchase.

formats.name: SAAS (Software as a Service)
formats.description: Software offered as a service, typically with recurring monthly or annual subscriptions.

formats.name: Prompt Contract
formats.description: A structured prompt for AI agents consisting of four sections: Goal, Constraints, Format, and Failure. This guides the agent to deliver specific outcomes and handle unexpected situations.
formats.rebuild_hint: Define a clear 'Goal' (outcome, not action), list 'Constraints' (what the agent cannot do), specify the exact 'Format' of the desired output, and outline 'Failure' conditions (how to handle errors or missing info).

formats.name: Scroll-Driven Image Sequence Animation
formats.description: An animation technique where a sequence of images is displayed on a canvas, controlled by user scroll position, creating a smooth, interactive visual experience, often used for product showcases.
formats.rebuild_hint: Extract video frames into an image sequence (e.g., WebP), render them on an HTML canvas, and update the displayed frame based on the user's scroll progress within a tall scroll container using JavaScript and CSS sticky positioning.

formats.name: Product Deconstruction Animation
formats.description: An animation showing a product transitioning from its assembled state to a deconstructed or X-ray view, revealing internal components.
formats.rebuild_hint: Generate a start frame (assembled product) and an end frame (deconstructed/X-ray product), then use an AI tool like Cling to generate intermediate frames for a smooth transition.

formats.name: Generative Workflow Layout
formats.description: A layout pattern where individual creative steps (e.g., character generation, scene setup, camera settings) are represented as distinct, interconnected nodes on a canvas.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a node-based graph library (e.g., React Flow, D3.js) to represent interconnected steps. Each node can be a component displaying an image, text, or specific UI controls.

formats.name: AI Model Selection Component
formats.description: A dropdown or pop-up menu allowing users to select from a list of different AI models for image or video generation.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a modal or dropdown with a list of selectable items, each representing an AI model, potentially with icons or version numbers.

formats.name: Cinematic Camera Settings Component
formats.description: A UI component displaying and allowing adjustment of camera parameters like type, lens, focal length, and aperture.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a card or pop-up with distinct sections for camera, lens, focal length, and aperture, using text labels and input fields/sliders for values.

formats.name: AI Agent Workflow Diagram
formats.description: A visual representation of how different AI agents and external tools interact, showing data flow and delegation. Uses nodes for agents/tools and arrows for connections.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a diagramming tool (e.g., Mermaid, Draw.io) to connect nodes representing agents and tools with directed arrows indicating data flow and delegation.

formats.name: Supervisor Builder Workflow Structure
formats.description: A specific multi-agent workflow pattern where a 'supervisor' agent (OpenClaw) plans and delegates tasks to an 'executor' agent (Hermes), which then performs the work and learns from each iteration.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a two-tier agent system: a high-level supervisor agent for planning and delegation, and a lower-level executor agent for task execution and self-improvement through iterative learning.

formats.name: Three-Pane Agent Dashboard
formats.description: A dashboard layout featuring a left navigation sidebar for listing workflows/agents, a central main content area for detailed task execution and results, and a right sidebar for displaying learned patterns or contextual information.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a responsive three-column layout. The left column for navigation, the middle for primary content, and the right for secondary/contextual information. Use clear visual separation and consistent styling.

formats.name: Instagram Carousel
formats.description: A multi-slide social media post with a consistent visual theme, layout, and typography across slides.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a design tool like Canva to create multiple pages with a unified brand aesthetic, including specific fonts, colors, and image placement, then export as a multi-page PDF or sequence of images for Instagram.

formats.name: Scheduled Task List
formats.description: A list pattern for displaying tasks with their scheduled times and recurrence.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a vertical list with each item containing a task name, time, and frequency. Include an icon for status or type.

formats.name: Ready to Review Task List
formats.description: A list pattern for displaying completed tasks that require review, with an associated action button.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a vertical list where each item shows a task name, completion status, and a 'Review' button.

formats.name: Daily Command Center Dashboard
formats.description: A dashboard layout designed to provide a daily overview of various work-related metrics and tasks.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a multi-section dashboard with summary statistics, task lists, and calendar views, using a dark theme for visual clarity.

formats.name: Inbox Summary Dashboard
formats.description: A dashboard layout for summarizing and categorizing incoming information from different sources.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a multi-panel dashboard with distinct sections for different types of information (e.g., priority, email, trends, updates).

formats.name: AI Agent Workflow Loop
formats.description: A conceptual loop describing how AI agents operate: Goal (define objective), Plan (break goal into steps), Tools (utilize resources like browser, email, docs, calendar), Execute (perform one step), Check (verify if the step worked), Retry/Adjust (if not, attempt again or modify approach), and Finish (stop when complete or blocked). This loop allows agents to work through a task chain instead of stopping after one answer.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement an iterative process with distinct states for goal setting, planning, tool selection, execution, validation, and conditional retry/completion. Each state should transition based on the outcome of the previous one.

formats.name: Parallel Agent Architecture
formats.description: A system where a single input is processed by multiple specialized sub-agents running in parallel to produce various outputs.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a system with a central orchestrator that distributes tasks to specialized AI models (sub-agents) concurrently, then collects and integrates their outputs.

formats.name: Information Hierarchy Structure
formats.description: A two-tier folder structure. The top tier is a 'My Business' folder containing files like 'About me', 'About My Business', 'About My Voice', 'My Offers'. The second tier consists of 'Project' folders (e.g., 'Newsletter') each containing subfolders for 'Instructions', 'Voice', 'References', 'Examples', and 'Notes'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a root folder. Inside, create a 'My Business' folder with markdown files for core business info. Create separate 'Project' folders for each initiative, each with markdown files/subfolders for project-specific instructions, voice, references, examples, and ongoing notes.

formats.name: Markdown Business Files
formats.description: Markdown files used to store structured information about a business, including personal details, business offerings, brand voice guidelines, and product/service details. Uses markdown headings for organization.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use markdown (.md) files for 'About me', 'About My Business', 'About My Voice', and 'My Offers'. Structure content with headings (##) and bullet points for clarity.

formats.name: Markdown Project Files
formats.description: Markdown files within project folders to provide specific context and guidance for AI tasks. Includes 'Instructions' (master instructions, index), 'Voice' (project-specific tone), 'References' (context, research, SOPs), 'Examples' (best past outputs), and 'Notes' (ongoing feedback).
formats.rebuild_hint: Within each project folder, create markdown files for 'Instructions' (e.g., CLAUDE.md), 'Voice' (if different from universal), 'References', 'Examples', and 'Notes'. Populate with relevant text, links, and feedback.

formats.name: AI Image Generation Form Layout
formats.description: A two-column layout for an AI image generator. The left column contains a text input field for prompts, a set of radio-like buttons for aspect ratio selection, and a primary action button to generate the image. The right column displays the generated image with secondary action buttons for downloading and regenerating.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a flexbox or grid layout with two main columns. The left column should contain a textarea for user input, a group of styled radio buttons or toggles for aspect ratios, and a prominent call-to-action button. The right column should feature an image container, with smaller buttons positioned below or overlaid for download and regenerate functionalities. Use a clean, sans-serif font and a light color scheme.

formats.name: Animated Text with Simple Icons
formats.description: Used for introductory concepts and key takeaways, featuring text that animates onto the screen alongside minimalist icons.
formats.rebuild_hint: Combine animated text elements with simple, flat-design icons. Use a clean, light background and a consistent color palette for text and icons.

formats.name: Card UI
formats.description: Rectangular containers used for displaying agents, tasks, summaries, and options, often with text, icons, and buttons.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create rectangular containers with rounded corners. Use a subtle shadow for depth. Place text, icons, and interactive elements within the card. Adapt background and text colors for dark or light modes.

formats.name: Pricing Table
formats.description: A two-column layout comparing different subscription plans (monthly and yearly) with features and pricing.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create two distinct columns for pricing plans. Highlight one as 'most popular'. Include clear pricing, savings percentages, and a list of features with checkmarks. Use prominent call-to-action buttons.

formats.name: Form Layout
formats.description: Structured input fields for billing information, personalization details, or other data collection.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use clearly labeled input fields and dropdowns. Group related fields. Include a promo code section and a prominent submission button. Ensure clear feedback for user input.

formats.name: Dashboard Layout
formats.description: A multi-panel interface for managing agents, projects, and chats, typically with a left-hand navigation, central content area, and sometimes a right-hand sidebar.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a fixed left sidebar for navigation. The main content area can be dynamic, displaying lists, cards, or chat interfaces. A right sidebar can be used for context-specific tools or details. Use a consistent dark mode theme.

formats.name: Flow Visualization
formats.description: A visual representation of an AI agent's workflow, using connected nodes and arrows to show sequential steps and integrations.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a canvas area to display interconnected blocks (nodes) representing tasks or steps. Use arrows to indicate flow direction. Integrate icons for connected tools/integrations within the nodes. Allow for expansion/collapse of details within each node.

formats.name: Text-based Report
formats.description: Structured text output from an AI agent, presenting summarized information or a briefing in an easily scannable format.
formats.rebuild_hint: Format text with clear headings, bullet points, and bolding for emphasis. Organize information logically (e.g., 'Needs Your Attention Now', 'Today's Schedule'). Present within a scrollable content area.

formats.name: AI Prompt Structure for Productivity
formats.description: A structured format for AI prompts designed to automate and streamline daily work tasks, including sections for Role, Inputs/Pull, Workflow, Output, and Termination conditions.
formats.rebuild_hint: Define a clear 'ROLE' for the AI, specify 'INPUTS' or 'PULL' sources, detail a step-by-step 'WORKFLOW', define the desired 'OUTPUT' format and length, and set 'TERMINATION' conditions for when the task is complete.

formats.name: Project-based context setting
formats.description: A workflow within Claude where users create dedicated projects, define project-specific instructions in a special markdown file ("Instructions - CLAUDE.md"), and upload relevant files into a linked local folder. This provides persistent context for Claude's responses within that project.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a project structure within an AI assistant. Implement a dedicated instruction file (e.g., `instructions.md`) within each project folder that the AI can read for persistent context. Allow users to link local file system folders to these projects for file uploads and referencing.

formats.name: Recruiter Feedback
formats.description: A section in ChatGPT's response providing an overview of the resume's positioning, including a 'Target Role' and a list of 'Strengths' in bullet points.
formats.rebuild_hint: Present a 'Target Role' (e.g., 'Social Media Manager / Digital Marketing Assistant') and then list key 'Strengths' derived from the resume content (e.g., 'Social Media Management', 'Ad Management', 'Video Editing').

formats.name: Browser FPS Game Layout
formats.description: Full-screen first-person perspective with a central crosshair, and a minimal HUD at the bottom showing HP and Ammo.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use a canvas element for rendering, implement raycasting for 3D effect, overlay HUD elements.

formats.name: Procedural Graphics Generation
formats.description: Graphics (like the gun and environment) are drawn programmatically using code, rather than loading image files.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement drawing functions (e.g., 'drawGun(ctx)') that use canvas API or similar to render visuals based on mathematical descriptions or pixel arrays.

formats.name: Procedural Audio Generation
formats.description: Audio (like gunshots) is generated programmatically using code, rather than loading sound files.
formats.rebuild_hint: Utilize Web Audio API or similar to synthesize sounds based on frequency and duration parameters (e.g., 'playShot(hz)').

formats.name: Motion Graphic Sequence
formats.description: A sequence of animated scenes with text and graphic elements, following a script and brand style guide.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use Claude Design with a detailed prompt including script, brand style guide, and motion rules.

formats.name: Instagram Carousel Post
formats.description: A series of vertical images with text overlays, designed for social media platforms like Instagram.
formats.rebuild_hint: Generate images using AI (e.g., GPT Image 2) based on reference photos and detailed prompts, then add text overlays in an image editor (e.g., Photoshop).

formats.name: Map Animation
formats.description: An animated map showing geographic changes or historical events with text and camera movements.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use Claude Design with a detailed prompt including map style, camera movements, annotations, and historical data.

formats.name: Static Visual for Video
formats.description: A polished, static image with text, suitable for use as a title card or explanatory visual in a video.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use Claude with a prompt specifying brand style, topic, format, and desired visual style, exporting as PNG.

formats.name: Brand Style Guide PDF
formats.description: A PDF document outlining brand identity elements like color palette, typography, visual direction, and voice & tone.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use Claude with a prompt detailing brand name, niche, audience, colors, fonts, vibe, and reference styles.

formats.name: Loop Cycle Diagram
formats.description: A circular diagram illustrating the repetitive process of 'Gather', 'Work', 'Check', and 'Repeat when done is true' for an agent.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use SVG or canvas to draw a circle with four labeled segments and arrows indicating flow. Add a central text condition for stopping.

formats.name: Step-by-step Prompt Workflow
formats.description: A linear, turn-based interaction flow where a user prompts, the AI works, the user checks, and then prompts again, represented by a vertical list of cards with progress indicators.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a vertical list of interactive cards. Each card represents a step and can be highlighted when active. Include a progress bar or indicator for each step.

formats.name: Goal-oriented Dashboard
formats.description: A UI for defining a goal with parameters (e.g., target score, max tries) and visualizing progress towards that goal with a dynamic metric and an evaluator's status.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement an input field for goal definition. Use a circular progress component for the metric. Create a status card that updates based on the evaluator's output and shows attempt count.

formats.name: Time-based Scheduled Task Interface
formats.description: A UI for scheduling a prompt to run at regular intervals, displaying a timer and dynamic status cards for the tasks being performed.
formats.rebuild_hint: Include an input field for the loop command and interval. Use a circular timer component. Display task status updates in dynamic cards that change content based on the loop's progress.

formats.name: Local to Cloud Deployment Diagram
formats.description: A visual representation of moving a computational loop from a local machine to a cloud environment for continuous operation.
formats.rebuild_hint: Draw two distinct icons (e.g., laptop and cloud) with labels. Use an arrow to show the transition. Add text descriptions for the state of the loop in each environment.

formats.name: Proactive Feedback Management Workflow
formats.description: A scheduled routine that processes feedback items through a multi-step workflow (triage, fix, respond) with a goal to action all items.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a dashboard with a scheduled routine input. On one side, list feedback items. On the other, create a multi-step process with interactive buttons or checkboxes to mark completion for each step.

formats.name: Parallel Fixes and Judge Workflow
formats.description: A dynamic workflow that explores multiple solutions in parallel and uses an AI agent to judge and select the best outcome.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a central node for the problem. Branch out to multiple parallel nodes representing different solutions. Converge these branches into a 'Judge' node. Use lines and arrows to show flow.

formats.name: Loop Configuration Panel
formats.description: A UI panel for adjusting parameters related to loop complexity, resource budget, and stop conditions.
