formats.rebuild_hint: Implement sliders for numerical values (complexity, budget) and checkboxes for boolean options (stop conditions, turn caps, intervals). Display current values clearly.

formats.name: Informational Comparison Table
formats.description: A structured table format used to compare different products or services based on their features, access methods, and primary use cases. It includes distinct headers and content cells, with some cells containing bulleted lists.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create an HTML table or use a grid layout. Define clear column headers and populate rows with product details. Use bullet points for lists within cells. Ensure consistent typography and spacing for readability.

formats.name: File Attachment/Upload with Limits
formats.description: A UI pattern for attaching files to a message, which includes displaying error messages when file count or size limits are exceeded.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a file input component with validation for file count and size, displaying user-friendly error messages upon violation.

formats.name: Direct File System Interaction
formats.description: An AI application's ability to directly access and process files from the user's local computer file system without explicit uploads.
formats.rebuild_hint: Integrate with operating system file APIs or a desktop agent to allow the AI to read and write files directly to local directories.

formats.name: AI Agent Workflow Visualization
formats.description: A display showing the progress and steps taken by an AI agent, such as 'Read X files, ran Y commands, ran Z agents'.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a status bar or log display that updates in real-time with the actions and progress of background AI processes.

formats.name: Direct File Output
formats.description: The AI generating and saving ready-to-use files directly into a specified folder on the user's computer.
formats.rebuild_hint: After AI processing, use file system APIs to create and save generated documents (e.g., spreadsheets, PDFs) to a user-designated local folder.

formats.name: Context Window Comparison
formats.description: A visual representation comparing how two different AI models or modes handle conversation context, showing one compacting and losing details while the other retains full detail.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use animated bars or text blocks to illustrate the reduction or retention of information within a conceptual context window.

formats.name: The Council - How It Works
formats.description: A structured problem-solving flow involving five distinct AI agents (Contrarian, First Principles Thinker, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor) that analyze a problem from different perspectives, followed by a shuffled peer review process, and finally a chairman's verdict for the ultimate answer and next step.
formats.rebuild_hint: Define 5 AI agent personas with specific mandates and output requirements. Implement a mechanism to shuffle and peer-review their individual outputs. Conclude with a final synthesis by a 'chairman' agent.

formats.name: Shuffle & Peer Review
formats.description: A process where multiple answers (from AI agents) are shuffled and then reviewed by a set of peer review agents to eliminate bias before a final verdict.
formats.rebuild_hint: Take multiple inputs, randomize their order, and then pass them to independent reviewers for evaluation.

formats.name: Conversational AI Workflow
formats.description: A workflow where users interact with an AI agent using natural language prompts to generate and refine video content, receiving proactive creative feedback.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a chat-based interface where users can input text prompts. Integrate AI models for video generation and editing. Develop a feedback mechanism that analyzes generated content and provides creative suggestions based on conversational context.

formats.name: Floating AR Overlay
formats.description: User interfaces are presented as semi-transparent, rectangular overlays that appear to float in the user's field of view, allowing interaction while still seeing the real world.
formats.rebuild_hint: Use AR frameworks to render UI elements as transparent planes in 3D space, positioned relative to the user's gaze.

formats.name: Card-based Information Display
formats.description: Information, such as notifications or calendar entries, is organized into distinct, stackable rectangular cards within the AR overlay.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design individual UI components as cards with clear boundaries and content, then arrange them vertically or horizontally within a larger AR container.

formats.name: Custom Connector Modal
formats.description: A modal window for adding new integrations, featuring input fields for a name and a remote server URL, along with action buttons to cancel or add the connector.
formats.rebuild_hint: Implement a modal component with two text input fields and two action buttons (e.g., 'Cancel' and 'Add'). Include a 'BETA' label for new features.

formats.name: Multi-Platform Social Media Dashboard
formats.description: A central interface for managing multiple social media accounts, displaying a grid of platform icons, a primary post creation action, and a left-hand navigation for various management features like calendar, posts, inbox, analytics, and reviews.
formats.rebuild_hint: Design a dashboard with a header for user/account info, a main content area featuring a grid of clickable social platform icons, a prominent 'Create Post' button, and a persistent left-hand navigation menu.

formats.name: AI-Generated Content List
formats.description: A structured list format for presenting AI-generated content suggestions, where each item includes a title, detailed textual content, and associated social media platform icons to indicate where the content is suitable.
formats.rebuild_hint: Create a list or card-based layout. Each item should contain a heading (e.g., '1. Announcement'), a body of text, and a row of small, relevant social media icons.
